fields.name: picks_done
fields.description: Count of completed pick-ups in the execution so far. It is 0 at the first decision step. It goes up by one at each decision step whose own scene (the last frame) shows the gripper raised (height about 0.12 or more) with fingers partly closed (about 46-51%, not 100%), regardless of what the cube list says (the held cube may still be listed at its old table position; a 'held in the gripper' line in the execution steps is corroborating but not required). It does not change at decision steps whose last frame shows the fingers 100% open, even if a cube line is flagged 'lifted off the table'. e.g. 1
